summary: Ryanair Holdings PLC filed a 6-K on June 8, 2026, reporting open-market share repurchases of 8,721 ordinary shares at an average price of €24.074 and 447,300 ADS-equivalent shares at ~$28.85, from June 1-5, 2026, under its previously announced buyback program of May 20, 2025. All purchased shares are cancelled. The program is a capital return to shareholders, not a self-tender. The filing is a routine periodic disclosure of ongoing buyback activity. Investors should watch the pace of repurchases and any program updates.
